userdoc.notice: Contract to distribute rewards to depositors across all vaults that contribute to a Prize Pool. The contract supports multiple reward "promotions". Each promotion can define a different reward token, start time, epoch duration, and number of epochs. Promotions divide time into evenly sized epochs; and users  can claim rewards for each epoch. The amount each user gets is based on their portion of the Vault twab * vault contribution, where the vault contribution is fraction of prize pool prizes that the vault contributed during the epoch.
